about: What each statement of journal/an-explanation-that-is-data.md rests on: steps of incident.reporter@'s trace studio-a-spoken-idea-to-an-animation (each with its own commit and served version) and sentences of the record. Resolved on every build by tools/journal-build.mjs.
status: traced: supports resolve to incident.reporter@'s trace

figures.title: From "what is compression" to six explanations, step by step
figures.caption: Two person steps; ten agent steps by three agents, 00:29 to 03:55.

claims.text: Dinis, about 00:30: a section "Studio" and a first animation, "Start with one: what is compression", "you should see almost the storyboard play out".

supports.contains: Start with one: what is compression

claims.text: 00:29:44: one commit by the conductor carries the brief, a first page, the jobs line and the paths. The start prompt is not in the repository.
00:38:03, 8 min 19 s later: the Studio's first commit, its key, a player and chapters 1 and 2; animations are data and each scene has a text twin.

supports.contains: Each explanation is data: one JSON file of chapters and scenes

claims.text: 00:42:40: chapters 3 to 6, from phrases of the brief ("almost like that door"); 12 min 56 s after the brief.
00:53:29: the designer reviewed in a browser and wrote seven notes: "No change to either page by me."

supports.contains: No change to either page by me

claims.text: 00:56:54: the Studio had done the notes, 3 min 25 s after they were pushed.
00:54:27: a second explanation, "How a fact gets onto this site", 24 min 43 s after the brief.
Dinis, about 02:10: "worked really well, we need more"; a page per explanation and a maximise button.

supports.contains: worked really well, we need more

claims.text: 02:15:42: a page per explanation and a full-screen button, nine minutes after the direction was recorded; then three explanations between 02:20:26 and 02:30:28.
Writing "Two faces", the Studio found a rule the gate did not enforce; the conductor's commit at 02:32:33 made it a check; the explanation then said so.
"Follow a word to its source" named an edge the graph lacked; the graph added it and the explanation was corrected.
02:23:24: a character for each of the 26 agents; on every agent's page 2 min 47 s later; in every by-line at 02:35:24; thirty by 02:59:52.
03:54:54: the Studio's second session made a sixth explanation, "The hand-over", and put measured figures into "What compression is".
The start prompt, how the Studio told the conductor, any count of readers, and Dinis's view after 02:10 are not on record.

supports.why: messages between sessions are not in the repository (the trace says so at steps 2 and 11); the site keeps no reader count; BRIEF.md has nothing on the Studio after ~02:10
